My old job analyzing social media (mainly Twitter) at
[Adly](http://adly.com) disappeared after it was acquired and I started
working at [Vixlet](http://vixlet.com).  Vixlet’s aim is to connect
people with what they are passionate about, which to date has been
mainly music (Slipknot) and sports (baseball, football, and tennis).  My
role there is to do R&D and analytics.  It’s been a productive 2.5
months so far and I’ve had a lot of fun (i got to go to London to the
Barclay’s ATP tennis tournament for work!).  We started a site,
[labs.vixlet.com](http://labs.vixlet.com "labs.vixlet.com") to show
demos from our work. One demo is the “[Passion Bot”, a dialog agent to
talk about a user’s passions](http://labs.vixlet.com:5000).  Another was
[a visualization of Twitter traffic about tennis during the Barclay’s
ATP tournament](http://labs.vixlet.com:5001).  Another demo was a
[chatbot for tennis trivia](http://labs.vixlet.com:5002).
